title: CertaRig capability manifest
description: What the agent principal may do on this rig. Every Edge tool is listed with a policy. Tools not listed are treated as 'never'. The manifest is hashed together with the rig config into the contract_hash that every mutating call must present.

approval_ttl_s.description: How long a granted human approval stays valid before it expires unused.

policy.description: allowed: the agent may call it directly. human_approval: a human must grant a single-use approval first. controller_approval: the deterministic kernel decides at call time (the policy only labels it). never: not exposed to the agent at all, refused even with a valid key.
